# Support

Use GitHub Discussions for help using BERTopic Tuning, choosing a corpus route,
selecting an assurance level, interpreting validators, or planning a
privacy-safe workflow. Search existing discussions before starting a new one.

Include:

- your goal and the relevant script or artifact;
- corpus route: `network-short`, `long-document`, or `mixed`;
- assurance level: `exploratory`, `research`, or `publication_release`;
- Python version and operating system;
- the exact command and complete non-sensitive output; and
- a minimal synthetic or otherwise privacy-safe fixture when it is needed to
  reproduce the question.

Do not post raw sensitive corpora, participant data, credentials, or
confidential research artifacts. Use [Security](SECURITY.md) for private
vulnerability reports and issues for confirmed, reproducible defects or scoped
feature proposals.
